facts.about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +16%/yr vs sales +7%/yr over 3 years
Operating margin expanded 5 pts in 3 years (25% → 30%)
Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 144% of PAT

business.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited designs, develops, and manufactures aerospace platforms, including aircraft, helicopters, engines, and space hardware. It generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing, repair, and overhaul of these defense and aerospace products for its customers.

segments.name: Manufacturing and Repair and Overhaul
segments.note: Covers aircraft, helicopter, engine, rotables, and spares.

guidance.statement: We are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.
guidance.quote: As far as revenue growth is concerned, we are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.

guidance.statement: The EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.
guidance.quote: And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

guidance.statement: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.

guidance.statement: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.
guidance.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.

guidance.statement: The guidance is 8% to 10% for the current year.
guidance.quote: But the guidance is 8%-10%, and it may so happen a double-digit growth from next year onwards.

guidance.statement: We will be maintaining 31% at operating level.
guidance.quote: we will be maintaining 31% at operating level.

guidance.statement: We have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.
guidance.quote: In line with our strategic goals, we have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.

guidance.statement: The aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores.
guidance.quote: The aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores and are expected to materialize within the next one to two years.

guidance.statement: We expect to bring it down further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: The manpower cost which used to be around 23% of the revenue during the year 2018-19, some 5 years back, has consistently been rationalized to almost 17% during the last financial year i.e. ‘23-24 and we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.

guidance.statement: The CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be between 14,000 to 15,000 crores.
guidance.quote: So, the CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores which translates into an average CAPEX of almost 3,000 crores on annual basis.

guidance.statement: We expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores by March 31, 2025.
guidance.quote: With these orders and the other ROH order book as on the 31st March ‘25, we expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores even after liquidation of the certain portion of order as part of the revenues for the year ‘24-25.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins should be at the minimum level not less than 29%.
guidance.quote: Broadly what we expect the EBITDA margins should on the most optimistic note it could be somewhere—around 32% to 33%. And at the minimum level it should be not less than 29%

guidance.statement: We will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.
guidance.quote: And as we have indicated in the few last calls, we will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.
This, again, I would like to clarify that may not be sustainable at 31%. We will settle down at 26%, 27%.

guidance.statement: We expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year, which means within a time span of 6 to 10 months.

scorecard.promised: Double-digit growth from FY25 onwards, maintaining 8-10% in FY26.
scorecard.delivered: FY25 revenue grew 1.98% to ₹30,981 cr; FY26 grew 6.8% to ₹33,089 cr.
scorecard.evidence: FY25 revenue of ₹30,981 cr vs ₹30,381 cr (FY24) is only ~2% growth, far below the 10% promise.

scorecard.promised: Maintain around 30-31% at operating level for FY26 and FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margins were 31% in FY25 and 30% in FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Annual margins hit 31% (Mar 2025) and 30% (Mar 2026), aligning perfectly with guidance.

scorecard.promised: Outstanding order book of ₹1,20,000 crores by March 31, 2025.
scorecard.delivered: Pipeline estimated at ₹1 lakh crore with ₹90,000 crore expected over next 2 years.
scorecard.evidence: Management shifted focus to a ₹1 lakh crore pipeline in Q4 FY25, suggesting the ₹1.2L cr target was aggressive.

scorecard.promised: Bring manpower cost down to 16% of revenue in FY25.
scorecard.delivered: Not explicitly disclosed, but margins remained stable at 31%.
scorecard.evidence: While specific % is missing, operating margin expansion from 25% to 31% supports cost rationalization claims.

scorecard.promised: Invest ₹14,000-15,000 crores over 5 years (approx ₹3,000 cr annually).
scorecard.delivered: Capital work in progress stands at ₹3,313 cr as of March 2026.
scorecard.evidence: CWIP of ₹3,313 cr matches the guided annual run-rate of ₹3,000 cr.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully defended high margins and executed capex, but consistently fails to meet its double-digit revenue growth promises.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Receivables have been brought down to 55 days, which is the optimal level.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Debtor days stand at 45 days as of March 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: We are confident of sustaining growth momentum with a robust order book.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth slowed to 1.98% in FY25 and 6.8% in FY26.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: EBITDA margins will settle down at 26-27% in FY24.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margin for FY24 actually reached 32%.

bull: Operating margins expanded 5 percentage points in 3 years, reaching a stable 30-31% range.
Exceptional cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow at 144% of PAT.
Strong balance sheet with zero net debt and ₹41,041 cr net worth.
bear: Revenue growth is stagnant, missing double-digit targets for two consecutive years (FY25 and FY26).
Cash conversion cycle has deteriorated significantly to 788 days from 475 days three years ago.
LCA Mark-1A deliveries face repeated delays, now pushed to August/September 2026.
watch: LCA Mark-1A delivery commencement in Q2 FY27 to validate supply chain recovery.

claims.claim: We are hopeful that by August or September, we should be able to start the deliveries.
claims.quote: So we are hoping to resolve everything and stabilize by August or September.

claims.claim: We are identifying multiple vendors to mitigate risks and maintain delivery schedules.
claims.quote: what we are trying to do is we are trying to identify more than one vendor for the supply of items, whether it is indigenous or from a foreign source.

claims.claim: We do not expect cost increases for FY27 as inventory is already purchased.
claims.quote: The inventories are there, and only some components may come, for which the purchase order has already been placed 1 year back or 2 years back. So there will not be any cost increase.

claims.claim: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December.
claims.quote: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December. This is confirmed, and they will be sticking to this schedule.

claims.claim: We expect to fly the prototype in the next year, 1st Quarter of next year.
claims.quote: Mark-2 is now at the manufacturing prototype stage, and we expect to fly the prototype in the next year, 1st Quarter of next year.

claims.claim: The 240 engines order will be liquidated over 8 years at a rate of 30 engines per annum.
claims.quote: the AL-31FP engine is 240 engines, which we will be delivering at the rate of about 30 engines per annum. So, over 8 years, this order will be liquidated.

claims.claim: We have capacity to produce 30 helicopters per annum at Tumkuru.
claims.quote: So, we have capability capacity in Bangalore as well as our new factory in Tumkuru, where we will be able to produce the number is about 30 helicopters per annum.

claims.claim: We are confident of sustaining this growth momentum with our robust order book and a very strong pipeline.
claims.quote: With our robust order book and a very strong pipeline we are confident of sustaining this growth momentum.

claims.claim: Inventory stands at 159 days, which we feel is the most optimal level.
claims.quote: today it stands somewhere around 159 days which we feel it's the most optimal level below which we would not intend to reduce further.

claims.claim: Receivables have been brought down to 55 days, which is the optimal level.
claims.quote: it has now been brought down to 55 days which is again the optimal level. I think that will be maintained in the next few years as well.

claims.claim: We want to augment the capacity to 24 numbers to expedite the delivery of the 83 Mark 1A.
claims.quote: We wanted to augment the capacity to 24 numbers because we want to expedite the delivery of this 83 Mark 1A and anticipating further orders which is also I think you are aware that another 97 also is likely to come.

claims.claim: Deliveries are on track to commence from February 2024, with 3 aircraft scheduled for delivery in FY24.
claims.quote: As per the contracted delivery schedule, the delivery should come on from February '24 onwards. And in the current financial year, we are supposed to deliver 1 fighter and 2 trainer

claims.claim: The design is robust and safe; recent incidents are not design-related and are being addressed via control rod reinforcement.
claims.quote: It is nothing to do with design adequacy as such. So the helicopters are safe in the present configuration also.

claims.claim: We are pursuing export leads in multiple countries and expect a breakthrough order within the next year.
claims.quote: And we are quite involved in these various discussions, and we are awaiting one breakthrough order to happen, which we are very positive, it should happen in the next 1 year timeframe.

risks.text: Non-compliance with board composition and committee requirements due to vacant independent director posts.
Significant liquidated damages recognized in profit and loss due to manufacturing and delivery delays.
Potential impairment of intangible assets and development expenditure based on project viability and feasibility.
Related party transactions exist, though none were material during the fiscal year.
